source.authority: European Parliament and Council of the European Union
source.text: The controller shall consult the supervisory authority prior to processing where a data protection impact assessment under Article 35 indicates that the processing would result in a high risk in the absence of measures taken by the controller to mitigate the risk.

applicability: GdprControllerProcessorRole.role in ['CONTROLLER', 'JOINT_CONTROLLER'] && GdprImpactAssessment.dpiaConducted == true && GdprImpactAssessment.residualHighRisk == true
